_comment: LiSenNet NPU variant: the dual-path GRU bottleneck is replaced by a dual-path CONV bottleneck (DualPathConv) so the model compiles to the STM32N6 Neural-ART NPU (GRU recurrence does not map; the 2-axis nn.LayerNorm in DualPathRNN is also gone since DualPathConv uses the already-primitive CustomLayerNorm). intra-frequency mixing = symmetric depthwise freq conv; inter-time mixing = stack of causal dilated depthwise time convs (dilations 1,2,4 -> ~0.5 s receptive field at hop 256). Retrained from scratch (RNN checkpoints do not transfer). Everything else (sub-band U-Net, magnitude-only mask, Griffin-Lim / noisy-phase, CMGAN losses) matches configs/lisennet.json.
